bio.text: Tim Walberg represents Michigan's 5th District in the U.S. House of Representatives, serving his ninth term, and chairs the House Education and Workforce Committee in the 119th Congress.
Before Congress he was a pastor in Michigan and Indiana, president of the Warren Reuther Center for Education and Community Impact, and a division manager for Moody Bible Institute.
He served in the Michigan House of Representatives from 1983 to 1999.
